1160 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 1600 rule not needed for this century).  
09-01-1160 is September 1, 1160.  
Subtract 57 days: August has 31 days, so back to August 1 is 31 days earlier (September 1 → August 1).  
Remaining 26 days to subtract: July has 31 days, so July 6 (July 31 → July 6 is 25 days back, plus 1 more day to July 5).  
Thus 57 days before September 1, 1160 is July 5, 1160.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1160-07-05
